<thought>We need to apply retrosynthetic template ID 42 (mapped_rxn “CC(=O)OC(C)C>>CC(=O)C”) to each of the three target SMILES provided in the previous answer. Using the apply_template tool will give all possible precursor combinations for each target. After obtaining the results, we will format them as a list of lists of SMILES strings as required.</thought>
<action>apply_template</action>

}</action_input>
